narrative.overview:
Quiet, precise and organic. Real work, stories and retained artifacts lead; tools and settings sit in contextual controls or the navigation disclosure. The compound leaf expresses a connected body of work without competing with its readable account.

Use compact reading rows, restrained serif work titles, sans operational headings and inspectable evidence. The private record is primary; portfolio and audience views are selective projections. Empty, excluded and unavailable states stay explicit.
keyCharacteristics: Work and stories before their machinery.
Evidence beside the account, on demand.
Night for private work; day for published reading.
A compact moving compound leaf with a readable fallback.

rules.name: The Surface Face Rule
rules.body: Private operations use night; published reading uses day. Nested previews bind their face explicitly. There is no preference toggle. Primary action text and focus on day need their existing component-level day treatments.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve the accent for at most two meaningful moments per screen. Separate decorative dividers from the stronger control-edge role. Attribution states remain unordered; excluded is distinct from invalid input and retains its reason.

rules.name: The Measured Metric Rule
rules.body: Metrics use the mono family and `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Labels use ordinary sentence-case sans rather than decorative eyebrows.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Use canvas, panel and raised grounds with edges for grouping and state. No box shadows. A divider separates content; a control boundary must remain identifiable on its actual ground. Avoid nested ornamental panels around ordinary rows.

dos: Do consume package token roles and shared controls; keep page styles focused on composition.
Do show retained artifacts only when present and preserve original accounts and evidence.
Do use mono tabular numerals for metrics and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do record measured contrast for the actual surface and state.
donts: Don't invent work, collaborators, evidence, scores or success states.
Don't add decorative underlines, shadows, bounce, spin or the superseded coil mark.
Don't spread the accent, organic corners or ornamental containers across every control.
Don't treat source adoption, a historical screenshot or a green test gate as current browser or deployment acceptance.
